text: Easy: What does WYSIWYG stand for in the context of KompoZer?
choices: What You See Is What You Get
Where You See Is Where You Go
Who You See Is Who You Get
What You Say Is What You Get
explanation: KompoZer provides a web page editor which has a simple graphical interface known as WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get).

text: Easy: Which keyword is used to allocate memory for a new object in Java?
explanation: The keyword 'new' is used to create the object by allocating memory.

text: Easy: What is the primary function of the 'R' software?
explanation: R is a free software environment for statistical computing.

text: Medium: What is the difference between the GET and POST methods in HTML forms?
choices: GET sends data as a block; POST appends it to the URL.
GET appends data to the URL; POST sends it as a block.
GET encrypts data; POST does not.
explanation: GET method retrieves data... attaching it at the end of the URL. In POST method, the data is sent as a block through the HTTP transaction.

text: Medium: In Java, how do you determine the size of an array named `list`?
explanation: With array variable, length is an attribute or property of array; whereas with String object, length is a method. So we need to use `list.length`.

text: Hard: In the R environment, what does the '+' prompt indicate?
choices: The previous command is incomplete and requires more input.
explanation: Observe that for long commands, when we press ENTER before the command is complete, R issues the + prompt until we complete the command.

text: Easy: Which HTML tag is used to create a multi-line text input area?
explanation: The Textarea element allows multi-line text input. The tag `<textarea>` is used to implement this element.

text: Medium: What is the specific purpose of the `RationalPlan Multi` version?
choices: To manage interdependent projects sharing common resources.
explanation: RationalPlan Multi allows us to manage projects that share company resources... It allows connections between tasks pertaining to different projects.

text: Hard: What specifically happens to the default constructor in a Java class if you define a parameterized constructor?
choices: It is no longer available and must be explicitly defined if needed.
It creates a compilation error immediately.
explanation: In presence of user-defined constructors in a class, default constructor is no more available.

text: Easy: Which file extension represents a Java bytecode file?
explanation: When the program gets compiled... compiler creates a file with extension .class... This is our Java bytecode file.

text: Medium: In KompoZer, which tab displays the HTML source code of the current element only?
explanation: The Split tab displays the HTML source of the current element. (The Source tab shows *all* details).

text: Hard: What is the limitation of the 'Preview' mode in KompoZer regarding scripts?
choices: It opens a separate browser window.
explanation: The Preview mode offers the page view as seen in a browser... The scripts do not run.

text: Easy: Which input type allows a user to select multiple options from a group?
explanation: Checkbox: Creates checkboxes in the form. Multiple check boxes can be selected at a time.

text: Medium: Which method in the `Arrays` class is used to fill an array with a specific value?
explanation: Method `fill` is used to fill the whole or partial array with specified value.

text: Hard: In a 2-D array declared as `int marks[][] = new int[5][3]`, what does `marks.length` return?
explanation: `marks` refers to the array of rows. There are 5 rows, so the length is 5.

text: Easy: What symbol is used for a single-line comment in Java?
explanation: Single-line comment: It begins with double slashes (//).

text: Medium: What does the `names.arg` argument do in the R `barplot` function?
choices: Sets the labels/names for the bars
explanation: `names.arg` to specify the values to be displayed for the bars.

text: Hard: Why can't a static method access an instance variable directly?
choices: Because static methods belong to the class, not an object.
Because static methods run before the class loads.
explanation: Instance variables cannot be accessed from class methods (static) because class methods are global to the class itself... (not tied to a specific instance).

text: Easy: Which view in Google Maps shows actual photographs of the earth?
explanation: By clicking on the Satellite button, we may switch to the satellite image view.

text: Medium: In data compression, what is the 'tar' format on Linux systems?
explanation: The tar file format puts multiple files in a single uncompressed file... (Compression requires gzip/tar.gz).

text: Hard: What is the specific result of `12.5 % 7.2` in Java?
explanation: The modulus operator works on floating point numbers. 12.5 % 7.2 yields a remainder of 5.3.

text: Easy: Which tag is used to create a submit button in an HTML form?
explanation: Submit: Creates a submit button... `<INPUT TYPE = "submit" ...>`.

text: Medium: What does the `toLowerCase()` method of the String class do?
choices: Modifies the original string to lowercase.
Returns a new string with characters converted to lowercase.
Checks if the string is lowercase.
Returns the length of the string.
explanation: `String toLowerCase()` returns a string with all characters of invoking string converted to lowercase (Strings are immutable, returns new string implied).

text: Hard: Which key is used to close the Site Manager pane in KompoZer?
explanation: You can close the site manager pane by clicking on close button or press F9.

text: Easy: What is VLC Media Player used for?
explanation: VLC media player... provides several options for playback of audio and video.

text: Medium: What is the difference between `float` and `double` literals in Java?
choices: Float is the default; double requires a suffix.
Double is the default; float requires an 'f' suffix.
explanation: Floating point literal by default is of the type double. To make a literal of type float, we have to append 'F' or 'f'.

text: Hard: In the data compression example, if the original file is 324 bytes, what is the compressed size?
explanation: While the size of the original file was 324 bytes, the size of the encoded file is just 226 bytes.

text: Easy: Which toolbar in KompoZer contains the 'Form' button?
explanation: Alternatively, you can also click on 'Form' in the composition toolbar.

text: Medium: In Java, are 'constructors' inherited by subclasses?
explanation: Note that constructors are not inherited in subclass.

text: Hard: What is the specific function of the `q()` command in R?
explanation: Exercise question 8: 'Which command is used to quit from R? ... (b) q()'.
